t: This is the Fazl Mosque, also known as The London Mosque, the first purpose-built mosque in London. It opened on 3 October 1926 in Southfields, Wandsworth. The construction and the land cost six thousand, two hundred and twenty-three pounds, paid for by donations from Ahmadi Muslim women in Qadian, Punjab. Between 1984 and 2019 it was the residence of the caliphs of the Ahmadiyya Muslim Community. It was designed by Thomas Hayton Mawson, the landscape architect, garden designer and town planner.
